messages:
Maria Gonzales: Support reported the zephyr-mini-4b-quant card still says max_seq 2048. Runtime supports 4096 with quant_profile=v2. Need PR to update limits, streaming caveats, and SDK snippets.

Sophie Lee: Will draft PR. Edits: limits table -> conditional 4096, compatibility note about kv-cache + streaming, python + TS snippets showing runtime_options and embeddings hybrid fallback, link to migrations/quant-profiles.

Ashok Patel: Confirmed on p4d: 4096 context works at ~1.2x memory. Bench: throughput ~80 tok/s, p99 ~1.0s vs 2048 ~135 tok/s. Uploading CSV.

Tanner Wu: Note for runtime: enable_kv_compaction=true recommended for quant v2 streaming to avoid re-compute and OOM. Add curl example showing runtime_options.

Li Huang: I'll add TS snippet and a unit test for streaming example. Example will show embeddings.create(..., embedding_mode="hybrid") fallback.

deploy-bot: PR opened by @Sophie Lee: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5012 (bench CSV + snippets).

qa-bot: PR #5012 checklist: limits updated, streaming note + curl, SDK snippets py/ts, migration link, bench CSV attached, add test vectors under docs/samples/zephyr-mini-4b/.

Sophie Lee: Tagging reviewers @Ashok @Tanner @Li. Will merge after approvals and add a one-line catalog changelog entry about quant_profile=v2 context expansion.
